skill.author: CuriousLearner

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown fences and placeholder Maven URLs. Confirmed issues involve destructive cleanup commands, a hidden home configuration overwrite, and a plaintext Maven server password example. No evidence found for prompt injection or data exfiltration intent.

remediation.suggestion: Prefer mvn dependency:purge-local-repository or narrowly scoped cache cleanup. Require user confirmation before any rm -rf command.
Use project-local .mvn/jvm.config when possible. If ~/.mavenrc is needed, append carefully after backing up existing content.
Replace sample passwords with placeholders and recommend Maven encrypted passwords or environment-backed secret handling.

content.value_statement: Maven projects often fail because dependencies, plugins, and profiles are hard to align. This skill provides focused guidance for setup, troubleshooting, testing, and CI configuration.
actual_capabilities: Explains Maven project creation with archetypes.
Guides pom.xml dependency and scope decisions.
Shows common compiler, test, packaging, and exec plugins.
Helps troubleshoot dependency conflicts and build failures.
Outlines Maven profiles, testing, coverage, and CI patterns.
limitations: Does not execute Maven commands by itself.
Example versions may need updates for current projects.
Assumes a Java project that already uses Maven.
Does not replace dependency vulnerability scanning.

use_cases.title: Start a Maven Project
use_cases.description: Create a standard Java project layout and choose basic Maven coordinates.

use_cases.title: Resolve Build Failures
use_cases.description: Diagnose dependency conflicts, plugin errors, and repository resolution problems.

use_cases.title: Prepare CI Builds
use_cases.description: Plan Maven test, package, cache, and artifact steps for CI pipelines.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a basic Maven Java project. Ask for groupId, artifactId, Java version, and package type.

prompt_templates.title: Add Dependencies
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my dependency needs and recommend Maven dependencies, scopes, and version management choices.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Build Errors
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Maven build failure. Explain the likely cause and give safe, ordered troubleshooting steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design Build Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a multi-module Maven build with profiles, testing, packaging, dependency management, and CI caching guidance.

output_examples.input: A developer asks how to add JUnit 5 to a Maven project.
output: Explains test scope and Surefire configuration.
Suggests running unit tests before packaging.

output_examples.input: A maintainer reports conflicting Guava versions in a Maven build.
output: Identifies dependencyManagement as the control point.

output_examples.input: A team wants a GitHub Actions Maven pipeline.
output: Describes checkout, Java setup, cache, test, and package steps.
Recommends keeping secrets outside the workflow file.

best_practices: Pin Java, plugin, and dependency versions through properties or dependencyManagement.
Run dependency analysis before changing transitive exclusions.
Prefer project-local configuration before changing user home Maven files.
anti_patterns: Copying build snippets without checking versions and scopes.
Deleting the whole local Maven repository as a first troubleshooting step.
Storing repository passwords directly in shared Maven settings examples.

faq.question: Can this skill create a Maven project?
faq.answer: It can guide project creation and provide Maven command examples. It does not run commands automatically.

faq.question: Does it help with dependency conflicts?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains dependency trees, exclusions, scopes, and dependencyManagement usage.

faq.question: Can it configure Maven plugins?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers compiler, test, packaging, shade, assembly, and exec plugin patterns.

faq.question: Does it support CI pipelines?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes GitHub Actions and GitLab CI build patterns for Maven projects.

faq.question: Will it scan dependencies for vulnerabilities?
faq.answer: No. Use a dedicated dependency security scanner for vulnerability detection.

faq.question: Is it safe to copy every command?
faq.answer: No. Review commands that delete files or change user home configuration before running them.
